_meta.notes: Identical retroactive batch filing to Rogers_W_10_YearEnd but for the 2011 year: 'Applies to 2010 County Council At Large B race' across the top, the Year-End box checked with '2011' hand-written next to the heading and the block circled, signed 5-2-12, clerk stamp MAY 04 2012. Summary Page is PDF page 4. All Column A cells are hand-drawn zeros; Column B carries the unchanged 295.98 aggregates with raised-superscript cents.

contributions.detail: exact: Schedule A (PDF p2) carries no itemized lines - the filer wrote 'None' in the first Name-of-Contributor cell - and its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE is a zero glyph; stated Column A line 1 is likewise 0. A real zero, not a gap.

expenditures.detail: exact: Schedule B (PDF p3) carries no itemized lines - 'None' written in the first Purpose cell - and its SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE is a zero glyph; stated Column A line 2 is likewise 0.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p2 (Sch A) rows 0 = printed SUBTOTAL zero glyph 'O'; p3 (Sch B) rows 0 = printed SUBTOTAL zero glyph 'O'. Both gates fire. NOTE the schedules' TOTAL lines do NOT equal their own subtotals: both print '295.98' (superscript cents) against a zero subtotal - the filer put the Column-B AGGREGATE on the schedule TOTAL line. Retained verbatim, not reconciled.
itemized.escalation_note: p2 and p3 re-rendered at 200 dpi with -normalize to screen for faint pencil entries in the empty grid; none present
itemized.notes: BLANK-SCHEDULE filing, honestly zero on both sides: Schedule A (PDF p2) and Schedule B (PDF p3) each print the full empty grid with the word 'None' hand-written in the first data row. Page order is NON-STANDARD - PDF p1 cover (form page 1), p2 Schedule A (form page 3), p3 Schedule B (form page 4), p4 Summary Page (form page 2). Cover carries a hand-written annotation across the top: 'Applies to 2010 County Council At Large B race', and the YEAR-END REPORT box is checked with '2011' hand-written and circled beside it - i.e. the 2011 year-end report for the 2010 race, consistent with the index. Summary Page Column A is a zero glyph on all seven lines; Column B lines 1 and 2 both read 295.98.
